changelog: Complete premium redesign of the weather console: matte command-center look, SVG icons, Doppler radar console with dBZ ruler.
Radar storm 'Dissolve' button now actually removes temporary storm cells.
Zone 3D placement now correctly returns to the console after confirm/cancel; sky camera releases NUI focus.
Tsunami alert and siren now stop properly; tri-regional mode and regional weather now persist across restarts.
Seasons set in-game are no longer reverted in calendar mode; permissions routed through acn_bridge IsAdmin.
Database loading waits for oxmysql tables before applying settings and zones.
